name: mq-observability-pack
description: Self-contained IBM MQ observability lab: ObservabilityPack manifest, OTel-native telemetry stack, synthetic canary, chaos harness and certification report generator.
author: Carlos Montero (https://github.com/MoebiusX)

scripts.validate: node tools/validate-pack.mjs && docker compose config --quiet && node tools/check-rules.mjs
scripts.lint: node --check harness/run.mjs && node --check canary/src/index.mjs && node --check tools/gen-dashboards.mjs
scripts.mqsc: docker compose exec mq runmqsc QM1
scripts.test: npm run lint && npm run validate:pack
